definitions.content: Fault greater than the verification scale interval, e.

notes.content: A significant fault does not include faults arising from simultaneous and mutually independent causes in the instrument or in its checking facility, faults that imply it is impossible to perform a measurement, faults that are so serious they will inevitably be noticed by all those interested in the measurement, transitory faults that are momentary variations in the indications that cannot be interpreted, memorized or transmitted as a measurement result.
